# Be Good — public pages

The documents Google Play requires to be readable by anyone, without an
account and without installing the app.

* `index.html` — the front page
* `terms.html` — Terms of Service
* `privacy.html` — Privacy Policy
* `sweepstakes-rules.html` — Prize draw, official rules
* `delete-account.html` — how to delete your account

**Do not edit these files here.** Every one of them is generated from the
app's own text by a script in the app repository, so that the website and the
screen can never say different things. Edit the app, run the builders, and
copy the output across.
